ἐπιμερ-ισμός , ὁ,
A.distribution, Hsch. s.v. ἐπινέμησις ; esp. in Gramm., “προσώπων”
A.D. Synt. 96.1
; ἐθνικῶν ib. 192.10 : abs., division of a sentence into words (μέρη λόγου), parsing, ib. 340.17 .
b.. Astrol., assignment, Vett. Val. 97.9 , Critodem.in Cat.Cod.Astr. 8(3).102.4 .
2.. ἐ. τῶν ἀπόρων allocation of irrecoverable contributions to wealthier taxpayers,
PFay. 53.5
(ii A.D.), cf. PAmh. 2.96.8 (pl., iii A.D.), etc.
3.. as title of gramm. works: ἐπιμερισμοὶ τῆς Α Ἰλιάδος parsings of words in Il. 1 , An.Par. 3.294 ; ἐ. Ὁμήρου κατὰ ἀλφάβητον parsings arranged alphabetically, An.Ox. 1.1 ; but ἐ. κατὰ ἀλφ. τοῦ Ἡρωδιανοῦ alphabetical arrangements of (not `by') Herodian, title of a spelling-list, Hdn. Epim. 1 , 157 ; later still ἐ. τῶν ἐννέα μέτρων analysis, digest, Trichas in Heph. p.365C. ; the nature of the lost Ἐπιμερισμοί of Hdn. ( EM 779.27 , Sch. Il. 4.66 ) is conjectural.
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
